posts.title: Honeybadger deployment tracking for Rails with Kamal and Doppler

posts.title: Setting up a Rails 8 + Kamal app with Doppler Secrets
posts.description: I recently started working on a new personal Rails project and was eager to try out Kamal and a secret manager called Doppler. I heard about Doppler on one of the Rails-related podcasts and loved what they had to say.
